beats.note: Moby-Dick, opening. Her mouth is on this voice, not a rendered track.
beats.text: Call me Ishmael. Some years ago, never mind how long precisely, having little or no money in my purse, and nothing particular to interest me on shore, I thought I would sail about a little and see the watery part of the world. It is a way I have of driving off the spleen, and regulating the circulation. Whenever I find myself growing grim about the mouth; whenever it is a damp, drizzly November in my soul; whenever I find myself involuntarily pausing before coffin warehouses, and bringing up the rear of every funeral I meet; and especially whenever my hypos get such an upper hand of me that it requires a strong moral principle to prevent me from deliberately stepping into the street and methodically knocking people's hats off, then I account it high time to get to sea as soon as I can. This is my substitute for pistol and ball. With a philosophical flourish Cato throws himself upon his sword; I quietly take to the ship.

sets_doc: Broadcast beat sets (the live loop, 2026-10-17; reworked by the demo thread 2026-10-20, docs/plans/DEMO-REWORK-20261021.md): a broadcast lap (CRISSA_DEMO_BROADCAST=1) plays set (lap mod 3). Every set: the listen loop under the disclosure lower third; synth beats (kind synth, beat cua|team|report|memory|mid|lookup: a question MADE by the question-maker, asked in the synthetic copy of the User's voice, answered live with her tools, graded on air; each carries its fallback say beat, the old recorded line, played when the synth switch is off or the buffer has none for that beat); a reading; the House Daily; home; a vetted live question. Set b keeps one krew placeholder (the show-off drill beats). A lap with the user in the chair, or CRISSA_DEMO_SETS=0, plays `beats` as before. Still beats (CRISSA_DEMO_STILLS, three a lap, 12 s each, the credit on the lower third): the User 2026-10-20 'someone cranked up the res and it looked great ... more of it'; every still is sized to the glass's art budget (config/demo-stills.json). Render beats (CRISSA_DEMO_RENDER, one a lap after the Daily, themed from config/demo-synth.json themes[].render): order live, score the next finished take live on CPU, verdict on the Wall; never draws in the lap, never installs. 2026-10-23 (the User: 'a great demo that shows off her various capabilities ... Creativity'): every set opens with chat-1 (small talk in the clone voice, her brain, no tools; kind chat, CRISSA_DEMO_CHAT), q-legal became q-case (she reads a whole public-domain opinion and briefs it; theme case-brief, seed rows only so it never goes empty), q-today follows the Daily (her browser on today's front page, the report dated today; theme today), chat-2 after the render (the next chat shape, often a loose ask she must pin down), and still-3 is the live clock (kind clock, CRISSA_DEMO_CLOCK).

limits._doc: NO LITERAL LIMITS (the User 2026-10-21: 'why do we limit her to four sentences? Remove.'; 'hate those hard coded limits'). Every limit on what she says or how long a beat may wait is a dial here, with what it guards and the measurement; a speech dial at 0 = off. lib/xspaces_live.limits() reads it per call; absent = LIMIT_DEFAULTS.
limits._speak_sentences: sentences she says from a hands result; 0 = all (was 1: the first sentence only)
limits._speak_chars: characters; 0 = no cap (was 480, set so a 90 s speech wait would finish; that wait now scales with the text)
limits._hold_wait_s: how long a beat waits for the room to clear (a line on air, a hands run); guards a stuck flag; measured: real holds end in 2-12 s
limits._speaker_wait_s: how long a line retries while the speakers say mic_busy; the house's post-speech cooldown is 12 s
limits._hands_timeout_s: lap-side cap on a hands job (was 58 s); 0 = none, her hands' own run budget (config/crissa-hands.json) ends a hung job
limits._speak_pieces: 1 = a line past the voice's 800-character cap is read in pieces on the house too, each ending on a sentence (house-speak HOUSE_SPEAK_HOUSE_PIECES; a pack always splits); 0 = one line cut at the cap. Measured 2026-10-23: the 902-character case brief aired as 704
limits._speak_wait: the wait for house-speak to finish a line: max(floor, 40 + chars x per_char); measured 397 chars = 28 s; guards a hung speaker, never cuts a playing line
limits._flourish_wind_s: a flourish on the glass when the lap starts: cue her listen loop and wait up to this many seconds before the opener; 0 = no wind-down (measured 10-27 lap 1 on +150: v2-fl-glance-door held the first beat ~35 polls)

_house_only: A beat with house_only: true plays on the house and is left out of the lap on any other install (2026-10-27: the House Daily has no source in a pack). Kill CRISSA_DEMO_HOUSE_ONLY=0.
